args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.2.2-beta (draft) for WoW Forever 1.60.1 (game build 71139)

Fixed
- The aura list in the diagnostics could be a secret table in a fight. That logged an error at every new buff. Fixed.

New (to find the blocked action bar buttons)
- The action button fields that the game's taint log named (action, autoCastEnabled) are looked at after every hook of every module and once a second. The first time one of them is a value WoWFA wrote, the chat and the report name the module whose hook had just run. Nothing is written.

From the earlier 1.2.2 drafts
- Item tooltips of the weapon enchant button are left alone by the buff module. The copy buttons no longer call the game's clipboard function. System lines reach the report again after a clear. Channel notices, NEW on the game menu, the macro window, a mount tooltip, Camp Benefits.

This build is for testing in game. Nothing of the game is written, and nothing runs in combat unless the combat option is turned on.
